concerns.text: The plan cites the **CLIP‑Microscope (csv)** dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/ernestoBocini/clip-microscope-imagenet/resolve/main/metadata/neuron_summary.csv) as the source of base images. This dataset consists of microscopy images of neurons and does **not contain human‑centric, socially relevant scenes** required for a moral‑judgment experiment. The specification (spec.md) and user stories explicitly call for open visual datasets such as **Visual Genome** that provide everyday scenes with potential moral ambiguity. Using a neuroscience image set therefore fails to provide appropriate stimulus material, violating the core research question and FR‑001/FR‑008.
